title: Argument membership under canonicalization
statement: Let $g$ be a directed acyclic graph gate and let $a$ be a natural number. The number $a$ occurs in the argument list of the canonical form of $g$ if and only if it occurs in the argument list of $g$.
hypotheses_covered: $g$ is a directed acyclic graph gate
